text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#4450 proxy-latency-surge prod-us-west — p95 > 800ms (3x) across frontend routers. Auto-escalation scheduled in 120s. Paging on-call.

maria: acked, i'm oncall. taking first touch. anyone seeing user reports?

alex: ack. no support tickets yet. checking routing and pool health.

jordan: quick glance at metrics — spike looks very narrow, started ~03:42 UTC, duration ~30–90s. linking grafana: https://graf.fake/g/XYz

incidentbot: (note) Subsequent duplicate pages suppressed by dedupe window.

maria: logs from proxy-3 look noisy, lots of queue waits and a few 502s. small snippet:
```
2026-03-15T03:42:11Z proxy-3 | queue_wait_ms=1248 calls=37 backend_err=2
2026-03-15T03:42:12Z proxy-3 | conn_pool_retries=4 kv_cache_miss=18
```

tilly-sre: hunch: short connection storm / cache-warm after microdeploy. i'll try a soft-scale of proxy pool and flip fallback routing to pool-b while we watch.

alex: running scale now:
```
./infra/scale.sh proxy-pool-us-west +2
kubectl rollout restart deploy/proxy-pool-us-west
```

jordan: nice. i'm watching tail latency and request queue depth. moving one noisy host out of rotation (proxy-3) via weight=0.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (no longer firing) — auto-resolve at 03:45:08 UTC.

maria: p95 back to ~120ms, error-rate normalized. support still no reports. looks like transient.

alex: confirmed proxy-3 weight=0, new pods came up, autoscaler added 2 replicas as requested.

tilly-sre: leaving a follow-up ticket: "PROD-1234 — transient proxy queue spike, investigate startup connection storms and KV cache prewarm". added checkboxes for load-testing and startup probe tuning.

maria: handing over for post-incident follow-up to @jordan. i'll add a short incident note in the ops doc.

jordan: will own the follow-up tomorrow; will pull logs for the 30s window and run repro locally. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incidentbot: Incident closed (auto).
